description: Long-lived Native Desktop performance telemetry gates. This layer proves Tauri command upload, Station ingest/query/rollup, local inspector diagnostics, and Station mirror sampler evidence.

logic.question: Can Desktop performance events flow through the product telemetry sink and return as queryable Station mirror evidence?
logic.invariant: Local buffer evidence can diagnose sampler coverage, but Station raw query and rollup remain the product evidence source.
